notes.title: 5-7-2021 to update-2
notes.content: Dog energy will enter the archive. If you carry a dog, the radiation value will not be increased when digging.

notes.title: 5-7-2021 to update
notes.content: The energy consumption of the dog is reduced. You can find the dog's skin in the scene. Click on the dog's skin to change the dog's skin.

notes.title: 5-5-2021 Update the pet dog
notes.content: Update the pet dog, you need to hunt rabbits, when you kill rabbits, your pet dog will take the initiative to eat, in the lower left corner of the backpack interface you can see the starvation value of the pet dog. Every time a rabbit is killed, the pet dog will get 5 points of nutrition.

notes.title: 5-4-2021 to update
notes.content: The card level bug has been fixed. After the non-toxic area is refreshed, the transmission will send the fixed point to the non-toxic area. When the non-toxic zone disappears or does not appear, the transmission position is random, and the duration of the non-toxic zone is prolonged by 200%. Sandstorm weather only appears in the jungle map. The use of props will be improved in future games, and the content needs to be updated later.

notes.title: 5-3-2021 to update-2
notes.content: In the game, adding houses can eliminate the pursuit of detectors and damage to dangerous walls. When the water and food value is 0, the game will prompt.

notes.title: 5-3-2021 to update
notes.content: First of all, I would like to thank Lhx for his advice. The suggestions have been revised and the content of the game has been added. I'm sorry, the monotony of the content of the game brings boring feeling to the players. In the game, the death file will be deleted, but the resurrection gold coin will be changed from the original 1000 gold coins to 100 gold coins, and the game upgrade speed will be increased to 500%. Backpack capacity increased by 15. There will be a safe in or near the house. The capacity of the safe is unlimited. The safe is archived. You can see all the stored items in any safe. The refresh probability of non-toxic area is greatly improved.Add marking function to task location.

notes.title: Weather system update
notes.content: The game weather system is updated to increase changes in fog and sunny days.
